import asyncio
from aiomonitor import Monitor
from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer
from aiomonitor.webui.app import init_webui

async def main():
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    m = Monitor(loop, max_snapshots=2)
    task = asyncio.create_task(asyncio.sleep(60), name='probe')
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    a = await m.capture_snapshot('keep')
    items = m.format_snapshot_task_list(a)
    item = next(x for x in items if x.name == 'probe')
    assert m.format_snapshot_task_stack(a, item.task_id)
    task.cancel()
    try: await task
    except asyncio.CancelledError: pass
    b = await m.capture_snapshot()
    assert any(x.task_id == item.task_id for x in m.format_snapshot_diff(a,b).removed)
    c = await m.capture_snapshot()
    assert [s.id for s in m.list_snapshots()] == [a,c]
    try: m.get_snapshot(b)
    except KeyError: pass
    else: raise AssertionError('eviction failed')
    async with TestClient(TestServer(await init_webui(m))) as client:
        r = await client.get('/api/snapshot/list'); assert r.status == 200, await r.text()
        r = await client.post('/api/snapshot/tasks', json={'snapshot_id':a}); assert r.status == 200, await r.text()
        r = await client.post('/api/snapshot/trace', json={'snapshot_id':a,'task_id':item.task_id}); assert r.status == 200, await r.text()
        r = await client.post('/api/snapshot/diff', json={'snapshot_id_1':a,'snapshot_id_2':c}); assert r.status == 200, await r.text()
        r = await client.delete('/api/snapshot?snapshot_id=999'); assert r.status == 404
        r = await client.get('/snapshots'); assert r.status == 200
    print('snapshot checks passed')
asyncio.run(main())
